about_the_game:
Another expansion, released to celebrate the anniversary of the original game—one that nobody asked for.

  • Three (or more?) new Alt Girls, tons of possibilities and variations.

  • The Alt Girls are voiced by Katya Sambuka, Arina Dead Blonde, and Maria Ovchinnikova (the official Russian voice of Jenny, the teenage robot from the Cartoon Network series).

  • A new inner voice – PAKHOM!

  • 13 (12+1) new endings.

  • New achievements that will make you feel uncomfortable if you don’t unlock them.

  • At least as big as the first expansion (meaning, quite large).

  • Mini-games—small but fun.

  • Unexpectedly pleasant impressions (not guaranteed).

  • An incredible expansion of the game’s lore.

Attention! This is additional content. The base game "Alt Girl for Skoof" is required to play.

content_descriptors.notes: Same as the main game. The game contains discussion of sexual themes, mentions of suicide and selfharm, mentions of taking alcohol, some nudity
